text: Mobilize Financial Services is a subsidiary of Renault Group; it is the commercial brand of RCI Banque SA, a French bank serving the customers and networks of Renault Group.
short: Mobilize Financial Services is a subsidiary of Renault Group.

source.name: BWT Alpine Formula One Team – Mobilize Financial Services partner page
source.quote: Mobilize Financial Services, a subsidiary of Renault Group, creates innovative financial services to build sustainable mobility for all.
source.note: The page continues: 'Mobilize Financial Services, which began operations nearly 100 years ago, is the commercial brand of RCI Banque SA, a French bank specializing in automotive financing and services for customers and networks of Renault Group'. The page itself carries no publication date; the date given is the date the page was opened.
